basis: Price return unless labelled total return (dividends excluded). Baseline Nov 4, 2024 close (session before the election). Nov 2024 is the post-election partial period Nov 5–29 only; the latest month is month-to-date.

meta.event: Donald Trump elected for second presidential term
meta.inauguration: Jan 20, 2025 (market closed, MLK Day; split uses Jan 17, 2025 close)
meta.vol_definition: Annualised realised volatility = std dev of daily returns within the month x sqrt(252) x 100
meta.nov2024_note: Nov 2024 is the post-election partial period Nov 5-29 only, not a full calendar month
meta.dow_tr_note: Dow Jones total-return index (^DJITR) has only 1 day of history on Yahoo Finance; Dow total return is NOT available - price return only, dividends excluded and disclosed.
meta.ndx_tr_note: Nasdaq-100 total return NOT shown: Yahoo ^NDXT is unreliable. Its ratio to the price index whipsaws instead of rising smoothly with dividends, and implies impossible monthly dividend gaps. A true TR/price ratio rises monotonically by the dividend yield (~0.7%/yr for NDX). NDX is shown price-only.
meta.spx_tr_note: S&P 500 total return from ^SP500TR is valid: TR/price ratio rises smoothly and monotonically, implying ~1.3%/yr dividends.

lag1.note: No lag effect in either direction.

correlations.yoy_note: YoY windows overlap (12-month rolling), so read the YoY correlation as a description of the trend divergence, not a clean statistical estimate; the MoM correlation is the cleaner read.
